notes.title: Major Patch Update: New Hunter, New Planet & More!
notes.content:
[h2][b]🎉 Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted - Patch Update 3 🎯💥 [/b][/h2]

[u][b]Patch Update V. 0.2.4b[/b][/u]

[b]New Character:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dhala – A mysterious and agile hunter has joined the chase. Master her swift moves and take down targets in style.
[/list]

[b]New Planet:[/b]
[list]
[*] Himmaphan – A treacherous new battleground filled with formidable enemies and two powerful bosses: Xing and Viper.
[/list]

[b]New Gameplay Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Hunter Skills – Each hunter now possesses a unique skill, adding more depth and strategy to your playstyle.
[*] Accelerated Difficulty – The further you go, the harder the fight gets. Stay sharp, or become the bounty.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Black Market Revamp – Perks are now sold individually for each hunter, allowing for better customization.
[*] Rebalanced Hunter & Monster Stats – Fine-tuned stats to encourage more cooperative play.
[*] Cursor UI Enhancement – Improved color visibility for better tracking during intense battles.
[/list]


⚔️ Update your build and jump back into the action!

notes.title: New Hunter Joins the Fray!
notes.content:
[h2][b]🎉 New Patch Update: A Fresh Wave of Chaos Awaits! [/b][/h2]

[u][b]Patch Update V. 0.1.8e[/b][/u]

[b]New Character:[/b]
[list]
[*] Jaz, a character who uses rhythm-based mechanics.
[/list]

[b]Game Feature Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the charging system.
[*] Removed the grenade system.
[*] Added a skill resource system. This new system allows players to use charge attacks without holding the charge button.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Trick Shot" visual feedback always appears on the host player's screen, even if the trick shot is performed by another player.
[*] The Drone prop may malfunction if a player disconnects.
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b]
[list]
[*] The grenade system is being redeveloped to make it more intuitive and easier to use. 
[/list]

Don’t wait—download now and start your bounty-hunting journey. Let us know your thoughts and tag us in your gameplay moments!

notes.title: Playtest FAQ: All You Need to Know!
notes.content:
[h2][b]🎮 Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted Alpha Test FAQ 🎮[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298137/e86c302046714332be6b65ce6fbb4b8fa53e0679.png[/img]

[b]Q: When is the alpha test?[/b]
A: The alpha test will run from November 25th to December 6th, 2024.

[b]Q: How can I join the alpha test?[/b]
A: Visit our Steam page and click the [b]“Request Access”[/b] button. Once approved, you’ll be able to download and play.

[b]Q: What platforms are supported in the alpha test?[/b]
A: The alpha test is available on PC via Steam.

[b]Q: What content is included in the alpha test?[/b]
A: Here’s what you’ll get to try in the alpha:
[list]
[*] 4 Hunters: Each with unique abilities and playstyles.
[*] 2 Bosses: Test your skills against challenging criminal bosses.
[*] Hunt Mode: A cooperative mode where you team up to take down dangerous targets.
[*] Play Options: Play with 1-4 players, both online and offline with friends.
[/list]
[b]Q: What input methods are supported?[/b]
A: The game supports both mouse + keyboard and controllers (Xbox, PS4, and PS5).

[b]Q: What should I know about perks in the game?[/b]
A: The current perks available in the alpha test are not the final design. We plan to introduce many more in future updates and make adjustments to allow deeper strategies when purchasing and using perks.

[b]Q: Do I need to pay to join the alpha test?[/b]
A: No, the alpha test is completely free.

[b]Q: Can I stream or share gameplay?[/b]
A: Yes! We encourage players to share their gameplay, screenshots, and feedback. Tag us on social media with #BountyBrawl!

[b]Q: Will my progress carry over to the full release?[/b]
A: Progress during the alpha test will not carry over to the full release, as this is primarily for testing purposes.

[b]Q: How can I provide feedback?[/b]
A: Join our [url=https://discord.gg/aszp77jv]Discord[/url] to share feedback or report bugs. We value your input to improve the game!

[b]Q: Will there be updates during the alpha?[/b]
A: Yes, we may roll out small updates or fixes during the alpha based on player feedback.

[b]Q: I have more questions. How can I contact you?[/b]
A: Feel free to ask in our Discord or message us directly on Steam or social media. We’re here to help!

[h2]👾 KNOWN ISSUES 👾[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some elite enemy has a chance to get "WEAKEN" in mid-air.
[*] The target indicator sometimes does not work.
[*] The coin counter in the top-left corner occasionally does not display.
[*] The joystick cannot be used to open the Options menu.
[*] Sweetshot’s ultimate attack sometimes malfunctions and does not show the laser beam.
[*] The Nuclear perk does not deal damage to props.
[/list]
